$note: A NON-conformant catalog kept as a fixture on purpose. WU-LEAN-0001 omits ten mandated fields and leans on `defaults` to supply them - the raw contract must REJECT it, and the opt-in resolver must be able to complete it. WU-LEAN-0002 additionally omits `output_path`, which `defaults` also offers; the resolver must REFUSE to fill it (identity and intent fields are never defaultable), so that unit stays invalid in both modes.

defaults.evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals, each anchored to a file:line or a reproducible command
tests_required: a both-states control: the check must fire on the bad state and be silent on the good one
defaults.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context
defaults.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot; enumerate at least two alternatives before a third attempt

work_units.title: A unit that leans on the defaults block for ten of its nineteen fields
work_units.question_or_target: Does the raw catalog contract reject a unit that only becomes complete after defaults are merged?

work_units.title: A unit whose output_path only exists in the defaults block
work_units.question_or_target: Does the resolver refuse to default an identity or intent field such as output_path?
